name: wind-aifinmarket
description: Wind AIFin Market aggregate plugin with 78 financial data, research, screening, trading-plan, risk, and quantitative workflows.
description_cn: 万得 AIFin Market 聚合能力，内置 78 个金融数据、研究、选股、交易计划、风控和量化工作流。

script_entries.name: wind_mcp

script_entries.name: wind_alice
script_entries.description: Run Wind Alice with the original user prompt and optional Alice Skill.

script_entries.name: tushare_query
script_entries.description: Call a Tushare Pro API by api_name with JSON params and optional fields.

script_entries.name: backtest_evaluate
script_entries.description: Evaluate a backtest result with the bundled methodology.

workflow: Search the bundled catalog before choosing a sub-skill.
Load only the selected sub-skill and references needed for the current task.
Use the declared script entry for data access or deterministic calculation.
Keep each sub-skill's declared data source and surface errors without silent source switching.
State the actual data source, query time, limitations, and financial-research disclaimer.
